payload.summary: WA public holidays: add the official 2028 list when WA publishes it, to confirm King's Birthday
payload.detail: src/lib/on-call/wa-public-holidays.ts now computes holidays by rule after the last published year (2027), and a test pins that the rules reproduce every published 2026-2027 date. King's Birthday is set by proclamation (assumed last Monday of September). When wa.gov.au publishes 2028 dates, add them to WA_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS, raise WA_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS_LAST_YEAR, and the reproduction test will flag any moved date.
